# Helios Platform

<!-- policy: descriptive -->

## Snapshot

Invented productivity suite whose enterprise tier bundles data protection
controls. Competes by inclusion rather than by shortlist, and is simultaneously
an integration target, hence the dual_role flag.

## Capabilities observed

- Data protection controls included in the top licence tier at no separate cost
  (vendor-primary, 2026-08-20).

## Gaps observed against stated buyer criteria

- Controls apply only inside their own suite. Buyers with mixed estates named
  cross-vendor coverage as a requirement (first-hand, 2026-08-05).

## Open questions

- Whether bundled controls will extend beyond their own suite.

## Positioning and messaging

> "Already included in your licence."

## Product surface

Suite-native only.

## Pricing and packaging

No separate line item. Cost is the licence tier upgrade.

## Partner intel

We integrate with them while competing with the bundled tier. Treat partner
conversations and competitive positioning as separate tracks.

## Recent moves

See signals/.

None.
